comment: Cycloalkene handler stereo fixtures.  Phase 152 wires the chain-fragment fallback (composer.py:~1756) through the predicate-first injector when features.ring_type == 'cycloalkene'.  Per D-10 the existing ring-strain filter at rules/stereochemistry.py:85-92 suppresses E/Z descriptors for ring double bonds in rings < 8 members; ring-atom R/S is unaffected.  All fixtures are sourced per D-23 from the multi-corpus benchmarks (chebi_5000.csv + opsin_selftest_500.csv) and round-trip through OPSIN 2.9.0 with the original SMILES.

compounds.comment: (3R)-methylcyclohexene -- known small cycloalkene, simple ring-stereocenter case
compounds.xfail_reason: pre-existing cycloalkene-handler output `(3R)-methylcyclohexene` lacks a `1-` locant after `cyclohex` per IUPAC rule; OPSIN cannot parse without locant. Phase 152 wiring correctly emits the prefix; the locant-format bug is owned by a separate phase.

compounds.comment: (6R)-6-methylcyclohex-3-en-1-one -- ketone on a cycloalkene; round-trips cleanly.
(5S)-2,5-dimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-ol -- enol on a methyl-cycloalkene; round-trips cleanly.
